note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Hamilton's official straight front render (38 mm case, 47 mm lug to lug and 20 mm lug width official; the render reads 45.4 mm because its lug ends are drawn short). Heights before the house depth scale are a front-relief reading of the official 9.5 mm (no side photo). Built with the watch_hamilton_h69439940 step. House method: modelled bead-blasted case, sloped bezel, lugs and crown, polished date frame and the polished hands with their lume; photo maps only for the dial print and the canvas strap.

case.note: Bead-blasted round flank up to the ridge at r 18.24 (render step); inner top below the dial

bezel.note: Wide bead-blasted ring sloping in to the crystal (render: 16.33-18.24 mm); slope direction inferred

crystal.note: flat sapphire just above the bezel's inner edge

strap.note: 20 mm green canvas (official lug width), house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

steel_blasted.note: bead-blasted matte steel (photo): case, bezel, lugs, crown

review.subtitle: Hamilton Khaki Field Mechanical 38 mm, green dial with date, green canvas strap
notes: Front reference is Hamilton's official straight-on product render (2100 x 2054 px, from the Bucherer listing); the photo you supplied is small (900 px) and slightly turned.

Case, sloped bezel, lugs and crown are modelled in matte bead-blasted steel; the polished date frame, the pencil hour and minute hands with lume, and the seconds hand with its round counterweight and lume arrow are modelled too. The dial print and the canvas strap come from the render.
Heights are estimated from the official 9.5 mm (no side photo).
